name: textley
description: Work with open Textley tabs and folder vaults on your Mac.
long_description: Connect Claude chat to Textley. Keep Textley open with MCP enabled. The app controls read-only and read-and-write access to open documents and selected vaults. Connected agents may send retrieved text to their AI provider.

access_token.title: Textley access token
access_token.description: In Textley, open Settings → Integrations → MCP and click Copy Access Token. Paste it here and keep Textley open.
